title: Migrate half-migrated internal events on Frontend
Description:
## Problem
While working on https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/415139, we have discovered that there are some events that have not been fully migrated to InternalEvents.

[Sentry seem to have caught](https://new-sentry.gitlab.net/organizations/gitlab/issues/?query=is%3Aunresolved+UnknownLegacyEventError&referrer=issue-list&statsPeriod=14d) some events that have not been migrated on the 
Frontend, while they have been migrated on the Backend:
```
p_analytics_ci_cd_pipelines
p_analytics_ci_cd_lead_time
p_analytics_ci_cd_deployment_frequency
```

Similarly not completely migrated events for the Backend have been discovered in https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/issues/439982 

## Desired Outcome

Events are fully migrated and related [sentry errors](https://new-sentry.gitlab.net/organizations/gitlab/issues/?query=is%3Aunresolved+UnknownLegacyEventError&referrer=issue-list&statsPeriod=14d) no longer show

## Possible Solution

We need to find the places where these events have not been migrated in the frontend and use the InternalEvents trigger in those.

title: Add support for diff_id in links to file in merge requests
Description: If you switch between different versions of a merge request you won't be able to link to a file or a file line for this specific version. The link to the file or the file line always points to the latest version. We should incorporate `diff_id` parameter for these links to support linking to different versions of the MR in files.
